name: Counting with restrictions
definition: A rule like these two cannot sit together changes the count. Two reliable moves: place the restricted objects first and fill in around them, or count everything and subtract the arrangements that break the rule.
recognizeWhen: they must not sit next to each other
the first digit cannot be zero
the two friends insist on being together
no two of the same colour may touch
misconceptions: I counted every arrangement and forgot to remove the ones that break the rule.
I placed the free objects first and then found the restricted ones would not fit.
I treated the pair that must stay together as two separate objects.
